verdicts.human_summary: Concurrency race: onGitStateChange() fire-and-forgets ensureWatchers(), so if a consumer unsubscribes before setup finishes, cleanup runs before watchers exist and the in-flight setup can still create dangling watchers with zero callbacks.
verdicts.reasoning: No AI comment addresses the race condition between unsubscription and in-flight watcher setup. The closest AI comments (3 about duplicate watchers on same path, 5 about lazy initialization readability) discuss entirely different concerns.

verdicts.human_summary: Infinite loop risk: if setupWatchers() completes but watchers remain empty (e.g., git dir missing or ENOENT), the while loop in ensureWatchers() immediately retries unboundedly. Suggests gating retries to stale generations only.
verdicts.reasoning: No AI comment identifies the unbounded retry/infinite loop problem in ensureWatchers(). AI Comment 1 discusses the empty catch block (logging concern), which is tangentially related to error handling in setupWatchers but does not identify or address the infinite loop control flow issue.
